chunks: It is narrated from Rūmī ibn Zurārah, from ʿUbayd ibn Zurārah, who said:

I said to Abū ʿAbdillāh عليه السلام: A Christian man marries a Christian woman with a dowry of thirty jars of wine and thirty pigs, then afterward they both embrace Islam, and he had not yet consummated the marriage with her.

He عليه السلام said: He should determine how much the pigs are worth and how much the wine is worth, then send that value to her. Then he may consummate the marriage with her, and they remain upon their original marriage.

key_terms.خَمْرًا: wine given as part of the dowry
key_terms.خِنْزِيرًا: pigs given as part of the dowry
key_terms.قِيمَةُ: the monetary value to be assessed

ai.seo_question: If a Christian couple embraces Islam after marrying with wine and pigs as dowry, does their marriage remain valid and what happens to the dowry?
ai.summary: This hadith gives a legal ruling concerning a non-Muslim couple who married with an unlawful dowry and then both embraced Islam before consummation. The Imam عليه السلام rules that the invalid items are converted into their monetary value, which is paid to the wife, while the original marriage contract remains valid.

en.bab-ul-qaim-publications: Hadith.4582 - It is narrated from Rumi ibn Zurarah, from Ubayd ibn Zurarah, who said:

I asked Abu Abdillah (as) about a Christian man who married a Christian woman with a dowry of thirty jars of wine and thirty pigs. Later, they both embraced Islam, and he had not yet consummated the marriage with her.

Imam (as) said: "He should assess the value of the pigs and the wine, and send that value to her. After that, he may consummate the marriage with her, and they remain upon their original marriage contract."
